To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

information technology is currently taking centre stage and transformed the world into a global economy, and that is increasingly dependant upon the creative management and dissemination of information, and that the enormous advantage it has in easing delivery of information around world.
information and communications technology (ICT) is an important enabler in the knowledge economy.
information technology has made a huge impact on the LIS sector in India, and the role of libraries has been enhanced.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of information and communication technologies (ICTs) on the LIS sector in India.
the impact of information and knowledge on the development of the LIS sector in the age of the knowledge and information society in India.
the impact of information and communication technologies (ICTs) on the library profession.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the impact of information and knowledge society on LIS is tremendous.
the LIS sector has been able to keep pace with modern information technology.

the information technology is a powerful tool for the development of LIS sector in India and it is a powerful tool in the hands of LIS professionals to make the LIS sector more effective and efficient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the library profession is facing a crisis of identity and is in the process of reinventing itself.
the library is the most important and essential institution of any society and it is the only institution that has been in existence for thousands of years and will remain so for thousands more.
the LIS in India has come a long way from the traditional role of a custodian of knowledge and information.
The main takeaway from our work is that

LIS has a major role in the knowledge society and the future development of LIS in India will depend on how the libraries are able to use modern information technology to provide better services and to cope with the challenges in the knowledge society.
the library and information science (LIS) community should not only focus on information and knowledge but also on the information society and its impact on the community.
LIS in the age of Information and Knowledge societies is a very important tool for the development of the society.
